title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Ratios and Proportions
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The sum of 3 positive integers is 180, and the ratio of the integers is 5:3:2. What is the value of the smallest of the integers?
questions.explain: Let the parts be $5x, 3x, \text{ and } 2x$. The sum is $5x + 3x + 2x = 10x = 180$, so $x = 18$. The smallest integer corresponds to $2x$, which is $2(18) = 36$.

questions.q:
In a particular cleaning solution, the ratio of concentrated solution to water is 3:40. How many cups of concentrated solution should be added to 5 gallons of water to make the cleaning solution in the given ratio?
(Note: 4 cups = 1 quart; 4 quarts = 1 gallon)
questions.explain: First, convert 5 gallons of water to cups: $5 \text{ gallons} \times 4 \text{ quarts/gallon} \times 4 \text{ cups/quart} = 80 \text{ cups of water}$. Let $x$ be the cups of concentrated solution. By proportion, $\frac{x}{80} = \frac{3}{40}$. Solving yields $x = \frac{3 \times 80}{40} = 6$.
